\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 238-241 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:GE-R246-first-pass-words-from-chapters-238-241}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to report and to visit.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a difficulty, safety, sense, a worry, a voice
  \item an atmosphere, an argument, university studies, a step, a fact
  \item a topic, a tradition, a dream, a surprise, the surroundings
  \item the environment, lessons, a difference, a cause, behaviour
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A difficulty? (\textbf{die Schwierigkeit}.) Safety? (\textbf{die Sicherheit}.) Sense? (\textbf{der Sinn}.) A worry? (\textbf{die Sorge}.) A voice? (\textbf{die Stimme}.) An atmosphere? (\textbf{die Stimmung}.) An argument? (\textbf{der Streit}.) University studies? (\textbf{das Studium}.) A step? (\textbf{die Stufe}.) A fact? (\textbf{die Tatsache}.) A topic? (\textbf{das Thema}.) A tradition? (\textbf{die Tradition}.) A dream? (\textbf{der Traum}.) A surprise? (\textbf{die Überraschung}.) The surroundings? (\textbf{die Umgebung}.) The environment? (\textbf{die Umwelt}.) Lessons? (\textbf{der Unterricht}.) A difference? (\textbf{der Unterschied}.) A cause? (\textbf{die Ursache}.) Behaviour? (\textbf{das Verhalten}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

Traffic? (\textbf{der Verkehr}.) Trust? (\textbf{das Vertrauen}.) A club? (\textbf{der Verein}.) Caution? (\textbf{die Vorsicht}.) An advantage? (\textbf{der Vorteil}.) A disadvantage? (\textbf{der Nachteil}.) The truth? (\textbf{die Wahrheit}.) Advertising? (\textbf{die Werbung}.) A competition? (\textbf{der Wettbewerb}.) A goal? (\textbf{das Ziel}.) To offer? (\textbf{anbieten}.) To accept? (\textbf{annehmen}.) To refuse? (\textbf{ablehnen}.) To lock? (\textbf{abschließen}.) To register? (\textbf{anmelden}.) To pay attention? (\textbf{aufpassen}.) To spend? (\textbf{ausgeben}.) To pronounce? (\textbf{aussprechen}.) To answer? (\textbf{beantworten}.) To end? (\textbf{beenden}.) To accompany? (\textbf{begleiten}.) To notice? (\textbf{bemerken}.) To advise? (\textbf{beraten}.) To report? (\textbf{berichten}.) To visit? (\textbf{besichtigen}.)
